paragraphs:
Irvine Valley College is a public community college in Irvine, California. It was established in 1979 as part of the California Community Colleges System. The University has the highest university transfer rate in California and is famed for its academic excellence. Approximately 430 international students from various nationalities study at Irvine Valley College annually.

What is the Irvine Valley College acceptance rate?

The Irvine Valley College acceptance rate is 100%.

The University has a range of first-rate student-use facilities, including labs and classrooms built for arts, science, engineering, and other specialized fields. The library empowers students with books, journals, online resources, and other facilities such as study spaces. The Fitness Center at Irvine Valley College encourages students to keep fit with various fitness classes available for people at all levels. An on-site gym, tennis court, soccer field, and fitness trail are also open on campus for student use. The performance arts center has events all year round.

Student Life

A connected community is developed through the many activities, events, and student clubs run across campus throughout the year. Peers runs more than 40 student clubs to provide access to a hive of like-minded people who want to pursue the same interests. The campus has plenty of green space for socializing or group study activities, and dining options are dotted around the campus for students' convenience. Students have reported finding it easy to get to their classes, and most first-year students live on campus, so the area has a buzz all year round.
